slug: 人在废丹房从征服师姐开始成仙
content_zh:
;;
“叶云，我真的很想要！”
“这……不合适吧？”
“少废话，难道你想逼师姐我用强？”
“那你可以试试……”
叶云双眼微眯，冷冷看着面前的青裙女子。
这个裴雨嫣，还当是自己的白月光吗？
他是个穿越者，来到这片玄天大陆已有数十年。
自小他就是个孤儿，与裴雨嫣相依为命。
叶云从小对她照顾有加，私定终身。
后来在他打多份工艰苦的奋斗下，总算赚够他们前来古道圣地的路费，并一同参加了入门考核。
作为东洲的霸主之一，古道圣地有上万年历史，底蕴深厚，无数修士心向往之。
裴雨嫣体质测出为玄阶，顺利上岸成为外门弟子。
他就比较惨了，体质为最低的凡阶下品。
好在圣地当时缺杂役，姑且将他收了下来，让他负责打扫与看管圣地的废丹房。
由于废丹普遍具有毒性，他这职位约等于是，看管有毒有害且不可回收垃圾。
后来裴雨嫣也随之变心，将与她的婚约取消，并表示以她的条件，以后理应配得上更好的人。
甚至在称呼上，也要求叶云叫她师姐。
此后叶云看管废丹房，与裴雨嫣少有机会见面，就这么兢兢业业几十年，临近退休，头发都已经白了许多。
甚至因丹毒的蚕食，他已经活不了多少年。

至于修为，则始终卡在凝气一重。
可没曾想天降机缘，上面某个长老竟赐予他一颗三品升玄丹，这外门弟子都梦寐以求的突破丹药！
说是为表彰他数十年如一日为圣地，实则就是想激励其它杂役，都能像他一样专心做圣地的牛马。
结果这消息传入裴雨嫣耳中，她居然来废丹房找叶云，要他将生玄丹交出来。
“叶云，以你的低劣天赋和年纪，服用升玄丹也是浪费，为什么就不能成全我呢？”
裴雨嫣身着一袭青裙，曲线曼妙的胸前起伏不定，看起来极为诱人。
作为修士，几十年过去她仍然是青春靓丽，看着叶云的神色中带着傲然之色。
“如果你答应，我可以给你玄晶和符箓。”
叶云暗暗冷笑，她手里有的玄晶，符箓，价值能跟生玄丹相提并论？
他皱起眉头，冷冷说道：“我都快死了，要这些有何用？服下升玄丹，或许我还能突破多活几年！”
“不行！”
content_en:
;;
"Ye Yun, I really want it!"
"Isn't this... inappropriate?"
"Stop talking nonsense, do you want to force me to use force, Senior Sister?"
"Then you can try..."
Ye Yun narrowed his eyes slightly and looked coldly at the woman in the green skirt in front of him.
Does this Pei Yuyan still think of herself as Bai Yueguang?
He is a time traveler and has been in this Xuantian Continent for decades.
He has been an orphan since he was a child, and he and Pei Yuyan depended on each other.
Ye Yun has taken good care of her since she was a child and has made a private decision for her life.
Later, with the hard work of working multiple jobs, he finally earned enough for their travel expenses to the ancient holy land, and they participated in the entrance examination together.
As one of the overlords of the East Continent, the Ancient Holy Land has a history of tens of thousands of years and has a profound heritage. Countless monks yearn for it.
Pei Yuyan's physique was measured as Xuanjie, and she successfully landed and became an outer disciple.
He was in a worse situation, with the lowest physique of a low-level mortal.
Fortunately, the Holy Land was short of handymen at that time, so we temporarily took him in and asked him to be responsible for cleaning and taking care of the abandoned alchemy room in the Holy Land.
Since waste elixirs are generally toxic, his position is equivalent to taking care of toxic, hazardous and non-recyclable garbage.
Later, Pei Yuyan also changed her mind and canceled the engagement with her, saying that based on her conditions, she should be worthy of someone better in the future.
Even in terms of title, Ye Yun was asked to call her senior sister.
After that, Ye Yun took care of the waste elixir room and rarely had the chance to meet Pei Yuyan. He worked hard for decades and as he neared retirement, his hair became much grayer.
Even due to the encroachment of erysipelas, he could not live for many years.
As for his cultivation, he is always stuck at the first level of Qi Condensation.
But he never thought that by chance, an elder above him would give him a third-grade Profound Profound Pill, a breakthrough pill that all outer disciples dreamed of!
Said to be in recognition of his decades of continuous service to the Holy Land, but in reality, he wanted to inspire other handymen to concentrate on being the Holy Land's oxen and horses like him.
As a result, the news reached Pei Yuyan's ears, and she actually came to the Waste Pill Room to find Ye Yun, asking him to hand over the Shengxuan Pill.
"Ye Yun, with your poor talent and age, taking the Shengxuan Pill is a waste. Why can't you help me?"
Pei Yuyan was wearing a green skirt, with her curvaceous chest rising and falling, looking extremely alluring.
As a monk, she was still young and beautiful after decades, and looked at Ye Yun with a look of pride.
"If you agree, I can give you the Xuan Jing and the Talisman."
Ye Yun secretly sneered. Can the Xuan Jing and Talisman in her hand be as valuable as Sheng Xuan Dan?
He frowned and said coldly: "I'm almost dead, what's the use of all this? If I take the Shengxuan Pill, maybe I can break through and live for a few more years!"
"No!"
